profile.description: 用于实验室自动扫描测量的控制模块，可协调执行器与探测器完成位置扫描、实时绘图、批量扫描以及 HDF5 数据保存，常用于显微成像、光谱映射和多参数测量实验。
profile.description_en: A laboratory scan-acquisition control module used to coordinate actuators and detectors for automated scans, live plotting, batch runs, and HDF5 data saving. It is commonly used in microscopy, spectral mapping, and multiparameter measurement workflows.
